title: Wii Essentials: Ghost Squad - MoeGamer
snippet: It wasn’t until 2007 that Ghost Squad would get a home release, with the port developed by Polygon Magic, a large and well-established company with its roots in arcade games dating all the way back to the mid-’90s. The game offered the full arcade game experience — only using the Wii Remote (with optional Wii Zapper mount) instead of a light gun — as well as Wii-exclusive four-player “Party” modes and a competitive “Training” mode.
